hero.lead: Donations Hub helps verified facilities publish real physical needs, while donors can review, accept, fulfill, and validate donations without any cash transaction through the platform.
hero.imageAlt: Serene mosque interior with prayer carpets and soft morning light

features.heading: Built for transparent physical donations
features.verifiedDesc: Rigorous vetting process for all masjid representatives and facility locations.
features.physicalDesc: Focusing strictly on tangible assets to ensure 100% of donor intent reaches the site.
features.proofDesc: Donors and vendors upload visual confirmation upon delivery and installation.
features.validationDesc: The local community confirms the presence and utility of the donated item.

roles.heading: Who can use Donations Hub?
roles.facilityDesc: Register your masjid to post verified physical needs and infrastructure requirements.
roles.donorDesc: Find and fulfill specific physical needs directly for communities in your area.
roles.vendorDesc: Partner with donors to supply and install specialized equipment for masajid.
roles.charityDesc: Monitor and coordinate large-scale physical donation campaigns across multiple facilities.

validation.heading: Designed to reduce fraud and increase confidence
validation.copy: Our verification loop ensures that every donation is not only delivered but also properly utilized by the community it was intended for.
